blocks.orig: The Canopy Migration Camp is a mobile camp that follows the infamous Great Migration. Whilst in the Ndutu area south of Serengeti (from mid-December to March), the camp offers a wonderful location to witness the migration when the herds of wildebeests and zebras gather for the birthing of their young ones. The camp boasts 11 spacious canvas tents powered by solar energy, each offering a cosy bedroom, an ensuite bathroom and a private veranda. You enjoy tasty and freshly cooked meals in the main restaurant tent and can share stories around the campfire at night.
blocks.html: As a mobile camp, the Canopy Migration Camp moves along with the infamous Great Migration. When it is set up in the Ndutu area in the south of Serengeti (from mid-December to March), it is ideally placed for watching the migration while the wildebeest and zebra herds come together to give birth to their young. There are 11 roomy canvas tents running on solar energy, each with a cosy bedroom, an ensuite bathroom and a private veranda. Tasty, freshly prepared meals are served in the main restaurant tent, and in the evening you can swap stories around the campfire.
